behavior: The client reads a job's quote at /w/<token> and accepts it with a typed name and email, then pays the deposit from the page
acceptance: /w/<token> (public, noindex, no sign-in) shows the issuer, title, scope, each payment (how it is invoiced, days to pay, amount) and the total; an unknown or deleted link says the quote isn't there.

Before acceptance a form takes the name and email, says accepting agrees to the work and payments, calls POST /v1/jobs/{token}/accept, then shows who accepted and when with focus there; a refused field is named on that field.
A made payment links its pay page while it can be paid (the deposit's as the page's main action), else shows its status pill.

The public e2e accepts a quote against fixed API answers and checks the form, focus, the deposit's pay link, a refused email and an unknown link; the live e2e opens a real job's /w/<token> signed out and deletes the job after, so nothing piles up (D-85: a real accept makes a 60-day deposit and a job that can't be deleted); axe finds no serious or critical violations and the page fits 390 px.
DESIGN.md describes the page; apps/web/AGENTS.md lists the public route.
